headline: GATES, NOT FEATURES (2026-09-17): 14 ops PRs merged today and almost all of them harden the seam rather than ship a surface — a PII gate on pre-commit, commit-msg, every PR/push and a weekly scan; a gitleaks secret scan; quality.yml routed through run-gates.mjs; registry severity honoured on a new sev1-sev3 axis; a bounded ralph-metric.yml; the watchdog enforcing the ops#238 supervised-path boundary; parked triggers on a daily cron. /ops/standing is now phone-operable and repo-filtered on every lane. Windows checkouts run the pre-push suite again after two path bugs and a lint-staged chunking fix. hirobius/hds merged 6 PRs building a Figma sync foundation (tokens to Figma model, push/snapshot/drift on Pro, Code Connect v2 templates generated from cva, honest README, ADR-025 Accepted) but PUBLISHING CODE CONNECT NEEDS ORGANIZATION OR ENTERPRISE and Pro cannot, so no Dev Mode snippet is live; nothing was published to npm and hds stays on v0.13.0. THE PII GATE SHIPPED WITHOUT ITS DENYLIST: PII_DENYLIST and .pii-denylist are Adrian's to create, so today it matches generic patterns only, which is how a client tenant's name reached a PR test fixture unflagged. ops#27's history rewrite is still pending. Four ops PRs and three hds PRs are open and every one waits on a human, not a session. THE FUNNEL STILL READS 0 CONTACTED.
next: ops#380, #387, #378, #384 are open and each waits on a human: #380 needs the OPS_AGENT_KEY Actions secret; #387 needs Supabase migration 0015 plus the import run by Adrian (it writes production); #378 is a draft needing a real eval run and ralph-approved; #384 is a draft that waits for the new hirobius.com to exist.
